svg.title: Inspected ESP32-S3 kit: conceptual layout
svg.desc: YD-ESP32-23 v1.3 board with ESP32-S3-N16R8 module, ApTechDeals 840-point breadboard with jumper wires, and Electrifier 1.3-inch 128 by 64 I2C OLED marked RG1.30 IIC v2.2. Its pads are labeled VCC, GND, SCK and SDA. Lines show relationships, not wiring. Both boards lack soldered headers. Controller, address and physical OLED operation remain unverified.

g.text: Inspected parts · concept only · see wiring guide for connections
Both boards have bare holes; secure electrical connections are required.
OLED controller, address and physical display test are still pending.
